lines.2: 「Why are you watching everything? Did you use an infinite combo on a foreigner at the arcade and make him mad?」
lines.4: 「Inori predicted I'd be in a traffic accident, so I'm on guard.」
lines.5: 「I'd tell you to stay home, but these days all kinds of things crash into houses. You can't relax there either.」
lines.6: 「Fine. Watching you die would give me nightmares, so I'll keep watch too.」
lines.9: 「Now! Cross the road like a duckling following its mother!」
lines.10: Kinu repeatedly beckons me with her hand.
lines.12: 「Why does everything they do have to attract attention...?」
lines.14: 「What is it, Nishizaki? Why are you saying the sound effect aloud?」
lines.15: 「Yohei... You don't secretly want to join that group... do you?」
lines.16: 「Of course not. I'm an honor student.」
lines.17: 「Good, a wide sidewalk. We should be safe here.」
lines.22: Something strikes my back with tremendous force!
lines.23: 「Hello, hello! Sorry! Did I hit someone?」
lines.24: 「Come to think of it, Subaru said bicycle accidents count as traffic accidents.」
lines.25: 「Regarding the fact that a mere bicycle has left Tsushima completely motionless...」
lines.26: 「Leo, wake up. If you don't, Princess will finish you off to hide the accident instead of helping.」
